primaryChecks.text: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.
contextRefs: JOS 19:46 — Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.
JOS 19:48 — This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
